lines: The Agent and W-Engine Signal Search Event period is as follows: 2026/11/11 12:00 (server time) – 2026/12/01 14:59 (server time). The Signal Search Event includes the following content:
"Answers in the Wind" Signal Search Details
During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank Agent Severian (Wind - Attack) is significantly boosted!
During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank W-Engine Incarcerating Grip (Attack) is significantly boosted!
During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank Agent Norma (Fire - Stun) is significantly boosted!
During the event, the reception rate for the limited S-Rank W-Engine Chief Sidekick (Stun) is significantly boosted!
The Final Callback - Audition Stage Details
• Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 8 and unlock the Event feature in the Main Story Prologue - Intermission

• Event Details: Proxies can try out Agents Severian (Wind - Attack) and Norma (Fire - Stun) in audition stages. Upon clearing the stage for the first time, Proxies can claim rewards on the results screen.
